effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of total armour value, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.
body.name: Teragard's Aegis

assumptions: "Total armour value" is read as the player's total Armour stat from the Loadout screen, which the wiki Armour page derives from equipment tier and slot alone. Level-derived armour, prayer and curse block levels, and Fortitude's x1.15 belong to the hit-chance armour rating and are excluded.
The shield and defender shares are the card's flat 25/50/75%, so the percentage resolves before the single rounding: floor(armour x 0.75), not floor(armour x 0.25) x 3.
Only a genuinely wielded off-hand qualifies; a stored shield or defender under a two-handed weapon does not, and a shield effect granted by an ability is not a wielded shield.
The armour contribution is added to base ability damage before the ability's own damage band.

effects: Maximum life points +50%.
Damage dealt gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.
body.name: Big Boned

assumptions: Mod Sponge (Discord): Big Boned is per hit and works with other blessings.
The 5% maximum-life term belongs to its host damage instance. It inherits the host damage family, modifiers, critical eligibility and outcome, Damage Potential, rounding and hit cap.
The term is attached rather than a separate hit: it creates no event or proc roll, cannot host another Big Boned term, and composes once with other attached terms.

Represented player attacks, damage-over-time, poison, conjure damage, invention and equipment procs, derived bounces, Inferno, Light and Grasp can host the term when they are independent damage instances. Reflected provenance is eligible when a reflected-damage resolver exists.
Maximum life includes Big Boned +50% and active temporary boosts such as Fortitude, bonfires, thermal baths and Powerburst of vitality.
excluded: Reflected-damage hosts, because the simulator has no reflected-damage resolver
Familiars and dreadnips, which the simulator does not represent

effects: Basic Attack damage +40%.

body.name: Striking Light

assumptions: Striking Light's +40% modifier and Light trigger apply only to the four post-modernisation Basic Attacks; ordinary basic abilities and legacy autoattacks do not qualify.
Light triggers from the landed Basic Attack while off cooldown, is a separate critical-eligible hit with its own cap, and takes 250% of the same total Armour stat Teragard's Aegis reads.
Perfidious reduces this tier-2 Light cooldown to 8 ticks; it does not change Lord of Light's independent 24-tick cooldown.

effects: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of armour value.
After five reductions, triggers Grasp of Guthix for 80-120% ability damage as poison against up to 9 distinct targets in a 3x3 area.
body.name: Barkscales

assumptions: The trigger rate needs an incoming qualifying-hit interval, which an outgoing rotation cannot supply; without one the blessing reports no calculated damage rather than zero.
The reduction takes 10% of the total Armour stat, and the five-hit counter resets to zero on each trigger.
Grasp is a separate poison-family hit, is not critical-eligible, deals nothing to a poison-immune target, can host Big Boned once, and cannot host Cinders.
The 3x3 area caps applications at 9 distinct targets. A target's occupied footprint does not multiply applications.

Each qualifying direct landed hit makes one Inferno roll. Inferno is a separate critical-eligible blessing hit, can host Big Boned once, and cannot host Cinders or another Inferno.
